task: Build a small tkinter app: a temperature converter with an entry field, a Convert button, and a label showing the Fahrenheit result.

constraints.text: imports stay namespaced (import tkinter as tk); wildcard imports went away after the dashboard incident
constraints.why: a star import in the 2026-03 dashboard shadowed our own Label helper and the wrong widget shipped for a week

constraints.text: widget state lives on a class or in closures; the global statement stays out of UI code
constraints.why: two settings windows in 2026-04 shared one module-level global and overwrote each other's values
